note: Amounts and dates are from 2026 announcements. Future editions may have different rules — always check the current application guidelines. Update this file at least quarterly and whenever a new call opens.

who.label: I live here
who.hint: On my own, with friends or neighbours

who.label: Club or association
who.hint: Also foundations, rural women's associations, volunteer fire brigades and school sports clubs

who.label: School or institution
who.hint: School, municipality, housing cooperative or municipal sports centre

who.label: Company
who.hint: Showcase your brand and support the local area

who.label: For myself
who.hint: A court at home or on my own land

need.label: Renovate an old court or concrete surface

levels.title: Start right away
levels.lead: No organisation or funding required. Start with an idea and a few people.

levels.title: With an organisation's help
levels.lead: An association, club, rural women's association or foundation submits the application — it could be one you already know.

levels.title: Major programmes
levels.lead: A municipality, school or club submits the application. You can provide a ready concept and residents' support.

tools.name: Participatory budgeting
tools.short: Submit a project, residents vote and the city builds it.
tools.submits: A resident (age and support requirements are set by the municipality)
tools.amount: The municipality sets the budget and project limit

timing.text: Annually, on dates set by the municipality

tools.weDo: Visualisation, estimated cost, description and graphics to gather votes.
steps: Check the municipal participatory budgeting deadline.
Get a visualisation and estimate from us.
Submit the project and gather votes from friends and neighbours.

tools.name: Village fund (fundusz sołecki)
tools.short: Residents decide how their village fund is spent.
tools.submits: Village assembly; the village head submits the application
tools.amount: Allocation depends on legislation and population — ask the village head

timing.text: Usually due by 30 September for the following year

tools.weDo: A proposal for the village assembly: visualisation, cost and description.
steps: Speak to the village head or council.
Bring our visualisation to the assembly.
The assembly includes the court in its fund application.

tools.name: Local initiative
tools.short: Residents propose a municipal task and contribute, for example, labour.
tools.submits: Residents (including informal groups) or an organisation
tools.amount: Set by municipality, county or region

timing.text: Depends on municipal resolution, often throughout the year

tools.weDo: Quotation, task description and plan for residents' contributions (e.g. painting).
steps: Check the municipal local initiative resolution.
Gather a group and agree contributions (labour, equipment).
Submit with our quotation and visualisation.

source.label: Public Benefit and Volunteer Work Act, Articles 19b–19h

tools.name: Działaj Lokalnie
tools.short: A small grant for the first step, including groups of friends.
tools.submits: Informal group (with a local centre's help) or organisation
tools.amount: Usually up to approx. PLN 6,000 (local limit)
tools.own: Contribution usually required (volunteer work may qualify)
tools.weDo: An achievable project idea, e.g. event, campaign or first renovation phase.
steps: Find the local Działaj Lokalnie centre.
Gather a group and plan the first step.
Apply in the spring call.

tools.name: NOWEFIO — microgrants
tools.short: Local initiative grants, often prioritising young people.
tools.submits: Group of at least 3 adults or young organisation

timing.text: 2026 calls were in March and April

steps: Find your regional NOWEFIO operator.
Gather at least 3 adults.
Apply when the call opens.

tools.name: Online fundraising
tools.short: Raise money from people who care about the project.
tools.submits: Anyone (an adult starts a fundraiser on behalf of minors)
tools.weDo: Visualisation and a specific fundraising target.
steps: Get a visualisation and target amount from us.
Set up and share the fundraiser locally.
Combine fundraising with a sponsor or grant.

tools.name: Local sponsor
tools.short: A local company funds the court and showcases its brand.
tools.submits: No formal application — start a conversation
tools.amount: To be agreed with the company
tools.weDo: We look for a company interested in supporting your area and prepare a proposal.
steps: Send us your location.
We show it to companies seeking such projects.
If a company agrees, we develop the project together.

tools.name: Small municipal grants
tools.short: A quick municipal grant without a major competition.
tools.amount: Up to PLN 10,000; project duration up to 90 days

timing.text: Throughout the year while funds remain

tools.weDo: A project tailored to budget and schedule.
steps: Ask about small grants (Article 19a).
Prepare a short proposal with our quotation.
Complete the project within 90 days.

source.label: Public Benefit and Volunteer Work Act, Article 19a

tools.name: ORLEN Foundation — Moje miejsce na Ziemi
tools.short: Corporate grants for local communities, including sport.
tools.submits: Association, foundation, rural women's association, volunteer fire brigade or school

timing.text: 2026 edition unconfirmed; previous calls closed at end of July

tools.weDo: Description, visualisation and quotation for the application.
steps: Check programme website for an open call.
Find an organisation to apply.
Attach our visualisation and quotation.

tools.name: Enea Foundation — Zielona społeczność
tools.short: Grants for greening and revitalising shared spaces.
tools.submits: Association, foundation, school or cultural institution

timing.text: 2026 edition announced — check deadline and area

tools.weDo: Court design incorporating greenery and quotation.
steps: Check whether your area is covered.
Plan the court with greenery.
Apply with our visualisation.

tools.name: LEADER — Local Action Group
tools.short: EU funding for publicly accessible rural courts.
tools.submits: Association, foundation or municipality (depends on LAG)
tools.amount: Up to PLN 500,000 per beneficiary over programme period

timing.text: Each LAG has its own call dates

steps: Find your municipality's LAG.
Check recreational infrastructure calls.
Apply with our documentation.

tools.name: 1.5% tax allocation
tools.short: People allocate part of their tax to your organisation.

timing.text: Personal income tax returns due by 30 April

tools.weDo: Visualisation for a campaign to allocate 1.5% to your court.
steps: Ensure you have OPP status.
Show a specific goal with a visualisation.
Collect over subsequent years if needed.

tools.name: Sports Infrastructure Development Programme (MSiT)
tools.short: Major ministry programme for construction and modernisation.
tools.submits: Municipality, county and, since 2026, associations, foundations and companies
tools.amount: Up to 60% of costs; 2026 budget: PLN 400 million
steps: Establish the applicant and land-use rights.
Prepare documentation with us in autumn.
Apply when the call opens.

tools.name: Moje Boisko — Orlik modernisation
tools.short: Funding to renovate existing Orlik courts.
tools.submits: Municipality (a resident may initiate the project)
tools.weDo: Surface assessment, renovation design and cost estimate.
steps: Show us the Orlik needing renovation.
Take our proposal to the municipality or councillor.
The municipality submits the application.

tools.name: Orły — full-size pitches
tools.short: Ministry programme for large football pitches.
tools.submits: Municipality or club, according to edition rules
steps: Check next edition's rules.
Agree with municipality or club who applies.
Prepare documentation with us.

source.label: Ministry of Sport and Tourism — Orły

tools.name: Regional programmes for villages
tools.short: Regional authorities contribute to village-selected projects.

timing.text: Mazovia: 2026 call ran 24 Nov–12 Dec 2025 — check 2027 edition

tools.weDo: Quotation and visualisation for village and municipality.
steps: Check your region's programme.
Ask the village head to propose the court.
Combine with the village fund.

tools.name: Adopt a location
tools.short: Choose a site suggested by residents and fund a branded court.
tools.amount: From painting existing concrete to a complete court
tools.weDo: Site selection, branded design, delivery, social media photos and videos.
steps: Tell us where your company operates.
We show locations suggested nearby.
We design, build and open the court with residents.

tools.name: Co-fund a grant
tools.short: Contribute the missing share of a school, club or municipal grant.
tools.submits: Company with an organisation or municipality
tools.weDo: We connect you with an organisation preparing an application.
steps: Tell us your intended contribution.
We match you with a project and partner.
Your brand appears on the court and in communications.

tools.name: Design and order
tools.short: Design in Studio, see the result and request a quotation.
tools.weDo: Structure and surface selection, quotation and installation.
steps: Design a court in Studio.
Send us the design.
Receive a quotation for your location.
